Instruction: Read the segment of a merger agreement and answer the multiple-choice question by choosing the option that best characterizes the agreement.
Question: Is “financial point of view” the sole consideration when determining whether an offer is superior?
Option A: No
Option B: Yes

Merger Agreement: SECTION 8.3. Consideration of Proposals. <omitted> (a) The Company Board shall evaluate any Acquisition Proposal based on the terms and conditions of such proposal, including the financial terms, and shall also consider the Company's strategic objectives, the potential impact on stakeholders, and the advice of its financial and legal advisors. (b) In the event that the Company Board determines that an Acquisition Proposal is a Superior Proposal, the Company shall notify Parent in writing and engage in good faith negotiations with Parent regarding the terms of this Agreement to potentially amend or modify such terms in order to make the existing Agreement more favorable to the Company. This notification shall include a summary of the material terms of the Acquisition Proposal and the identity of the party making such proposal. (c) The Company Board must also ensure that any decision made in connection with an Acquisition Proposal complies with its fiduciary duties under applicable law, which may require consultation with outside legal counsel and a financial advisor of nationally recognized reputation. (Pages 88-89)

Question: Is the 'financial point of view' the sole consideration when determining whether an Acquisition Proposal is a Superior Proposal?
Option A: No
Option B: Yes

Merger Agreement: SECTION 8.3. Board Considerations. <omitted> (a) The Company Board may, in good faith, effect a Change of Recommendation in response to an Acquisition Proposal if it determines, after consultation with its outside legal counsel and a financial advisor of national reputation, that the failure to do so would be inconsistent with its fiduciary duties under applicable law. (b) In making such determination, the Company Board shall consider, among other things, the financial terms of the Acquisition Proposal, the strategic benefits to the Company, and the implications for shareholder value. (c) The Company Board shall provide written notice to Parent of its intention to effect a Change of Recommendation at least five Business Days prior to such action, during which time Parent shall have the opportunity to propose revisions to this Agreement that may address the concerns raised by the Company Board. (Pages 102-104)
